verdict.rationale: Mercury's own marketing states that a single universal search bar finds any transaction, vendor, or card and jumps straight to creating payments and transfers. This matches the story element for element, but the claim rests on one first-party marketing line. Missing for 10: in-depth product documentation of the search feature (scope, filters, result types) and independent or hands-on corroboration that search-to-payment works as described.

support.subject: As a finance-lead, I can search across all transactions, vendors, and cards from one universal search bar and jump straight into initiating a payment

citations.quote: Find any transaction, vendor, or card, or jump straight to creating payments, transfers, and more — all from one universal search bar.
